format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-download-file id="d" file-name="Отчёт.pdf" file-size="2,4 МБ" href="/fixture/report" download></sf-download-file>
<sf-download-file id="d-off" file-name="Архив.zip" file-size="120 МБ" href="/fixture/zip" disabled></sf-download-file>

probes.title: href draws a native download link named by the file

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#d a.sf-download-file'); return a && a.getAttribute('href') === '/fixture/report' && a.getAttribute('download') === 'Отчёт.pdf' && a.textContent.includes('Отчёт.pdf') && a.textContent.includes('2,4 МБ'); })()

probes.title: a press sends sf-download-file-download, then the dated sf-download-file:click, one detail
a refused request stops the link

steps.script: (() => { window.__prevented = null; document.addEventListener('sf-download-file-download', (e) => e.preventDefault(), {once: true}); document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { window.__prevented = e.defaultPrevented; }, {once: true}); document.querySelector('#d a').click(); return true; })()

probes.title: disabled draws a disabled button and sends nothing

steps.script: (() => { window.__dl = 0; document.addEventListener('sf-download-file-download', () => { window.__dl += 1; }); document.querySelector('#d-off button').click(); return true; })()

probes.title: a size off the ladder reads as 1
